answer: Before any epoch claim settles, this bond rule challenges each account to open 10 random hash-tree branches from its own historical work log, binding a pearl salt, a summit block number, and an inlet record slot in under 50 ms. Stateless accounts that discard per-agent history fail the spot check and forfeit 400 bonded tokens. One honest agent pays 3 GB of disk storage once and keeps its full bond, whereas an operator running 250 sybil workers forfeits 100,000 bonded tokens, paying 5x more than the stolen reward share. This fails if a fast shared disk serves all 250 clones.
